decisions.reason: As a tightly fitting web-map add-on with evidence of early iterative support, it likely meets aspiration through complementarity with the core stack and would usually be retained unless folded into the platform.

Its functionality looks more niche and may fall short of rising aspirations in a growing market, but its close fit and likely low maintenance cost make continued retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
Because this platform is the firm's flagship strategic product line and central to its search and development path, management would keep it unless performance were clearly far below aspiration.
Mobile field data capture remains a strong complement to enterprise GIS projects, though higher upkeep and more uncertain standalone uptake leave a moderate risk of withdrawal if results disappoint.
